Recordings 1-6, 23, 46, 47, 50, 65, 69, 100 and 101 were built earlier on the CPU without --skip-lead-in; the other earlier ones on the CPU with --skip-lead-in; the remaining 89 with --skip-lead-in --gpu-fused (common/code/gpu_fused.py; checked on recording 11: identical rows from the first GT frame on, snr within 6e-5 relative). The search scores only from the first GT frame (--skip-start), so the lead-in difference does not enter the score. Verified .npz mirrors made with fred/utility/convert_cache_npz.py.

A first launch without --no-track (tracking defaults to ON in bayes_working_point.py) was stopped after 1 evaluation; its files were kept as *baseline_ss_box_f1.track_aborted.* and are not part of this search.
